changes: Retained Sefaria export verse positions corroborated by source Hebrew letters; nine differing readings were taken directly from Wikisource at the recorded revisions. Documented split and renumbering of the first two commandments. No OCR or new translation performed by Amudi.
sourceCreationMethod: The precise original digitization method is not established by this review.
